22. The maximum sentence provided by law for the offence of causing death by careless driving
when under influence of drink or drugs is imprisonment for life.

23. The offender must be disqualified from driving for a minimum period of five years, and until the
extended driving test is passed. When a sentence of imprisonment or detention is imposed,
the period of disqualification which the court would otherwise have imposed must be extended
by a period equal to half the sentence of imprisonment or detention.3
